outlook_text: Most parts of the ASEAN region are likely to experience showers in the next few days, except for the northern and central parts of the Mekong sub-region where drier conditions are expected. Isolated hotspots and occasional smoke plumes may occur if dry weather is prolonged over fire-prone regions. The prevailing winds over the northern ASEAN region are forecast to blow from the northeast to east, while the prevailing winds over the southern ASEAN are expected to be light and variable in direction.
